answer: One number: cost per identity per epoch. Fingerprinting costs a GPU-hour plus a distinct model hash, and a collision re-queues the submission to a second panel, which doubles the wait. Example from this week: 24 tasks, 3 collisions, 3 re-queues, average delay 40 minutes. A dawn-fresh farm burns one GPU-hour per account before it earns anything, so 1,000 identities is 1,000 GPU-hours against a mesa of work that pays per task, and a whisper of history does not skip the queue.
